purpose: Engineering diagnostic convergence, not specification or ENOB acceptance
cycle_rms_change: <= max(1 uV,0.1% of prior cycle RMS) for differential output
require_all: Every adjacent cycle comparison across both four-cycle windows; no clipping/nonfinite or omitted outlier
steady_gain: Not measured from initial step ratio; requires settled matched positive/negative input or sinusoidal transfer later
clarification_before_steady_test: Wait eight complete chop periods after the last control/input step, then evaluate two consecutive four-cycle windows aligned to rising CHOP. This is not overlapping the waiting and evaluation intervals.
